name: App shell
layerWhy: It is the place every other place sits in: a whole layout of the product's journey between places.
promise: The bar and the navigation hold still; the place changes.
expectation: A bar across the top, places at the side, the place itself.
evidence: Narrow, the navigation and search fold behind Show Menu, nothing lost; choosing a place closes the menu.
behaviour: Lays itself out by its own width.
The current place is marked in the navigation.
context: Every product with more than one place.
relationships: Next two moves: the other places at the side, the account in the bar.
accessibility: Landmarks: navigation and main, each named.
failures: Never moves the navigation between visits.
do: Keep places in the same order forever.
dont: Hiding search on a phone with no way to it.
